correctness.rationale: Exact P^k decomposition gives signed residual eigenvalue s=(-mu)^k, Perron trace rbar(1+s), determinant (r1*r2)s, and a strictly increasing Perron root with unique crossing s=-tau. In the subcritical case iterate domination by M^t implies extinction; at equality the positive left Perron vector yields a strict Lyapunov decrease and global extinction. In the supercritical case a Perron-vector subsolution, invariant all-ones supersolution, strong order preservation and strict subhomogeneity prove one globally attracting positive equilibrium. The exact-rational checker at verification/check_parity.py passed 68 migration power and trace/determinant cases, with numerical confirmation of a mixed source-sink witness. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The infinite-fast-mixing disease growth rate is greater than one while a strict initial sequence of odd migration counts can globally eliminate infection; every even movement count remains endemic. The sharp cutoff includes the critical case and holds for arbitrary admissible saturation strengths, resolving finite-k behavior not addressed by asymptotic separation results. It gives a motivated new qualitative disease-control boundary rather than a single numerical curiosity.
